info.name: AgentABI
info.description: Agent Compatibility & Upgrade Intelligence Platform — API collection. See docs/POSTMAN.md for setup. Bearer JWT auth is applied at the collection level via {{access_token}}; Health, GitHub OAuth login/callback, and the GitHub webhook override auth to none, matching their actual implementation.

request.description: Cannot be completed inside Postman — this redirects to GitHub's interactive authorization page. Open {{base_url}}/api/v1/auth/github/login in a real browser, complete GitHub login, and GitHub will redirect to /api/v1/auth/github/callback, which returns an AgentABI JWT. Copy that access_token into this environment's access_token variable. See docs/POSTMAN.md.
Requires access_token to be set (see the login request above).

item.name: Get Component Version by Version String

request.description: source_id/target_id must be two distinct, already graph-synced components.
source_trajectory_id must be a COMPLETED trajectory that actually invoked baseline_component_version_id.
Phase 7 ships no production executors, so this returns 503 ReplayExecutorUnavailable unless a test executor is registered — this is documented, expected behavior, not a bug.
Requires OWNER or ADMIN role in the organization; MEMBER gets 403.

Public endpoint — no Bearer auth. The pre-request script computes X-Hub-Signature-256 from github_webhook_secret (local testing only; leave that variable empty and the server will correctly reject with 401). Set github_delivery_id to any unique string per request; redelivering the same id with the same body is idempotent (2xx again), with a different body is 409.

exec: // Computes X-Hub-Signature-256 for local webhook testing only.
// github_webhook_secret must match the server's GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET env var.
// Leave github_webhook_secret empty to skip signing (the request will get 401).
console.warn('github_webhook_secret is empty — signature not set, expect 401');
